description: Find public Mesh events and current Coffee or Night outings. Existing members can prepare and confirm eligible outings in chat with events:join consent. The exact outing is shown before confirmation; chat joining uses no passes. Paid bookings, cancellations, private attendee data and general member-hosted event joining are unavailable. New members complete Mesh signup and account approval first.
